commentary.text: 90+5' The referee blows his whistle for the final time to end this match.

90+3' A dangerous towering header by Yangel Herrera (Girona) from around the penalty spot goes just wide of the right post. This corner kick didn't change the score. The ball is off of the pitch and it's a goal kick for Villarreal.
90+3' Girona get a corner.
90+2' Substitution. Ivan Martin makes his way off the pitch and Jhon Elmer Solis Romero (Girona) comes on as his replacement.
90+1' David Lopez goes off the pitch and Abel Ruiz (Girona) comes on.
90' The fourth official shows 4 min. of added time.

89' 0 - 1 It's a goal! Etta Eyong (Villarreal) makes it 0:1. He jumped highest to connect with a perfect cross from Alfonso Pedraza and planted his close-range header into the bottom right corner. Paulo Gazzaniga was helpless.
87' This yellow card was deserved. The tackle by Dani Parejo (Villarreal) was quite harsh and Isidro Diaz didn't hesitate to show him a yellow card.
85' Substitution. Etta Eyong (Villarreal) replaces Ayoze Perez.
82' Girona take the corner, but their hopes of scoring a goal end with a nice clearance by the defence.
82' The referee and his assistant both point at the corner flag. Girona will have an opportunity to threaten the opposition's goal.
80' A corner kick by Villarreal is thwarted by the well prepared Paulo Gazzaniga (Girona).
79' Yaser Asprilla (Girona) attempts to find the head of one of his teammates with a promising cross into the box, but a defender outjumps the attackers and averts the threat.
78' Great teamplay by Villarreal as they control the ball with a lot of short passes. Patience is the key if they want to find a gap in the defence to score.
74' We are about to witness a subsitution. Alfonso Pedraza (Villarreal) for Sergi Cardona.
73' Funez Salva decides to make a substitution. Portu will be replaced by Alejandro Frances (Girona).
73' Substitution. Bojan Miovski (Girona) receives a signal from the referee and is now allowed to enter the pitch as Cristhian Stuani walks off.
73' That will be all from Pau Navarro who is being replaced by the fresh legs of Willy Kambwala (Villarreal).
71' A quickly taken corner by Villarreal.
69' It must be a yellow card. It is. Yangel Herrera (Girona) receives the caution after an awful tackle.
68' Cristhian Stuani (Girona) gets on the end of a good pass and from mid-range he unleashes a decent strike, but the shot is blocked by the defender.
66' It will be a substitution. Gerard Moreno (Villarreal) is ready to enter the pitch as Yeremy Pino walks off.
66' Michel has decided to introduce fresh legs, with Yaser Asprilla (Girona) replacing Viktor Tsygankov.

64' Alex Baena (Villarreal) attempts to find one of his teammates with a ball from a free kick outside the box. The goalkeeper climbs high above all the players in the box to intercept the cross and snuff out the opportunity.

63' Arnau Martinez (Girona) was too fierce in his attempt to get the ball from his opponent and Isidro Diaz blows for a foul. Free kick. Villarreal will probably just try to cross the ball in from here.
60' Alex Baena (Villarreal) unleashes a decent shot towards the roof of the net, but Paulo Gazzaniga thwarts him with a nice save. Villarreal have been awarded a corner kick.
57' Viktor Tsygankov (Girona) whips the ball into the penalty area, but one of the defenders is alert and spanks it away.
55' Neat passing move from Girona in order to create new attacking opportunities.
54' The attendance for today's match is 12011.
53' Cristhian Stuani (Girona) is penalised for a foul. Isidro Diaz had a clear view and blows his whistle.
52' A great run by Nicolas Pepe (Villarreal) gets him into the box, but his powerful shot is bravely blocked by a defender.
51' Yangel Herrera (Girona) swings in a cross, but the ball is cleared to safety by one of the defending players.
49' The Villarreal players keep the ball and are exchanging a combination of passes. They are waiting for gaps in the defence to open up.

47' Alex Baena (Villarreal) makes a yard for himself on the edge of the box after picking up a pass, but produces a poor effort that sails high over the bar. The ball is off of the pitch and it's a goal kick for Girona.
47' Logan Costa (Villarreal) commits a foul during an attacking move.
46' The players are back out on the pitch following the half-time break and the second half is about to start.
46' The teams are back out for the second half and here is a change on the pitch. Marcelino gives a chance to Dani Parejo (Villarreal) and Pape Gueye is off.
45' The referee blows his whistle for half-time, bringing to a close the first 45 minutes of the match.
45' Arnau Martinez (Girona) sends a cross into the box, but Junior Reis comes off his line to gather the ball.
44' Girona seem to be finding their feet as they enjoy some possession. They are waiting for the right moment to create new attacking opportunities.
41' There's a melee in the box, but the referee isn't interested in the appeals from Villarreal for a penalty. Play continues.
39' Nicolas Pepe (Villarreal) makes space inside the box for a shot, but his effort goes just over the crossbar. The ball is off of the pitch and it's a goal kick for Girona.

37' Portu (Girona) is unable to control an accurate defence-splitting pass properly and one of the defending players reacts well to rob him of the ball. The ball is off of the pitch and it's a goal kick for Villarreal.
36' Girona seem to be finding their feet as they enjoy some possession. Great movement by the offensive players allows the defenders to set up the attack.
34' The Villarreal players are exchanging some short passes to try and open up the opposition’s defence and hit them swiftly on the break.
32' The defence is alert as they clear a dangerous cross from Viktor Tsygankov (Girona).
29' The free kick into the box finds Juan Foyth (Villarreal), who heads the ball towards the top of the net, but the keeper pulls off a fantastic reflex save. Great goalkeeping skills.

29' Yangel Herrera (Girona) clearly holds his opponent to prevent him from getting the ball and the referee blows his whistle for a foul. Villarreal win a free kick and will be able to apply some pressure on the opposition goal.
26' Portu (Girona) collects a pass on the edge of the box and unleashes a shot which is brilliantly blocked by a defender.
25' Ayoze Perez (Villarreal) makes a strong challenge and Isidro Diaz blows for a foul.

22' The ball is in the net but it’s immediately ruled out by referee Isidro Diaz due to a handball, much to the disappointment of the Ayoze Perez (Villarreal) and his team. Ayoze Perez (Villarreal) picks up a yellow card.
21' Girona control the tempo of the game by exchanging some accurate short passes.
18' Arnau Martinez (Girona) is unable to feed an accurate cross into the box.
15' Isidro Diaz shows a yellow card to Pape Gueye (Villarreal) for his blatant foul.
14' A good clearance by a defender means the corner comes to nothing for Girona.
13' Girona have a chance to score from a corner kick, but the ball is cleared by a defender.

12' Viktor Tsygankov (Girona) dinks a cross into the box in an attempt to find one of his teammates, but the defence manages to clear. The linesman points to the corner flag, Girona are going to take it.

10' Pape Gueye (Villarreal) gets on the end of a pass and tries a shot from the edge of the box, but it's a wild attempt that goes well wide of the right post. The ball is off of the pitch and it's a goal kick for Girona.

9' Paulo Gazzaniga displays his ability to read the game and clears the danger after Ayoze Perez (Villarreal) threatened to latch onto a through ball from just outside the box. The ball is out of play. Villarreal will have a throw-in.
7' Nicolas Pepe (Villarreal) goes on a solo run, but he fails to create a chance as an opposition player blocks him.
4' Girona are bossing possession at the moment by exchanging some precise passes from player to player.

2' The ball rebounds to Pape Gueye (Villarreal) and he shoots from distance, but the keeper calmly watches it drift well wide of the right post. The ball goes out of play and Girona will have a goal kick.
2' A cross from a mid-range free kick, taken by Villarreal, is intercepted by one of the defenders.
1' Ladislav Krejci (Girona) is booked after bringing down an opponent. Isidro Diaz had an easy-decision to make.

Girona will kick the game off.
